data_status: complete — Fiscal 2025 (nine months ended Dec 31, 2025) audited financial statements + Jan 7, 2026 full-year 2025 production release + Mar 19, 2026 fiscal 2025 results release + Q1 2026 MD&A reserve snippets read. Company changed FY-end from March 31 to December 31; FY2025 = 9 months ended Dec 31, 2025.

mines.mine_notes: Gold mine, Sonora, Mexico. FY2025 (calendar 2025): 17,793 oz Au + 57,493 oz Ag = 18,467 GEOs. Updated Technical Report published Nov 28, 2025 (eff. Oct 17, 2025). Growth: Veta Madre open pit expansion — 43,000 oz Au in reserves; prestripping ~11 Mt waste in 2026-27, first production H1 2027. Creston pit reserve 312 koz Au; ~27 Mt waste stripping planned from 2027 (requires additional permits), production from 2028. M&I resources (2025 NI 43-101, inclusive of reserves): 20.213 Mt @ 0.79 g/t Au, 10.4 g/t Ag = 514 koz Au, 6,775 koz Ag; Inferred 1.144 Mt @ 0.46 g/t Au, 35.1 g/t Ag = 17 koz Au, 1,291 koz Ag.

Open pit gold-silver mine, Durango, Mexico (30,000 tpd crushing, heap leach; carbon shipped to La Colorada for stripping/doré). Restarted Dec 2025; FY2025 (calendar 2025): 14,883 oz Au + 22,469 oz Ag = 15,139 GEOs. M&I resources (2025 NI 43-101, inclusive of reserves): 23.629 Mt @ 0.43 g/t Au, 12.2 g/t Ag = 325 koz Au, 9,229 koz Ag; Inferred 1.401 Mt @ 0.32 g/t Au, 9.4 g/t Ag = 14 koz Au, 421 koz Ag.

notes: FY2025 = nine months ended December 31, 2025 (changed FY-end from March 31). Calendar 2025 production: 32,990 oz Au + 80,527 oz Ag = 34,098 GEOs (incl. El Castillo, reclassified to closure in Q3 2025), within 31,000–41,000 GEO guidance; calendar 2025 cash cost $1,541/GEO, AISC $2,028/GEO (outperformed guidance). Fiscal 2025 (9 mo): revenue $91.8M, mine operating earnings $47.4M, exploration spend $13.3M, net income $12.4M; cash $40.6M, working capital $49.0M, no debt. 2026 guidance (announced Jan 13, 2026): 50,000–55,000 oz Au, 290,000–320,000 oz Ag; cash cost $1,850–1,950/oz, AISC $2,025–2,125/oz. Development/exploration pipeline (all Mexico, 100%-owned unless noted): Ana Paula (Measured 1.3 Mt @ 7.6 g/t Au + Indicated 2.97 Mt @ 4.44 g/t), San Antonio (55.5 Mt @ 0.98 g/t = 1.74 Moz Au Ind.), Cerro del Gallo, Goldstrike, Unga (USA). North Sonora project (Cumaro, La Lola, Oso Negro, Ejutla) sale to Zacatecas Silver agreed Mar 2, 2026 ($0.5M cash + $0.8M shares). Registered office: 1723-595 Burrard Street, Vancouver BC V7X 1J1. Tickers: TSX.V:HSTR / OTCQX:HSTXF / FSE:RGG1. La Colorada reserve tonnages not parsed from tech report (reserves 43k oz Veta Madre + 312k oz Creston cited in Q1 2026 MD&A) — verify in the Nov 28, 2025 technical report before publishing.
